publicOfferResearch.materialTerms: The introductory first-year prices are presented for qualifying new customers without an existing McAfee subscription. Plans auto-renew annually; the charge occurs within 30 days before expiry at the renewal price then in effect, which may change with advance notice. Vermont residents must opt in. Tax may apply. McAfee states a 30-day initial-purchase refund window and a 60-day refund window after an auto-renewal charge. Unlimited-device language is limited to supported household devices owned for personal, noncommercial use and is subject to fair use.
